title: Foundation
description: Establishment of the company in Gurugram by three engineer co-founders, as a specialist HVAC contractor.

title: National Recognition
description: Expanded operations across the nation, taking on HVAC mandates beyond the National Capital Region.

title: Global Recognition
description: HVAC partner for NTPC and BHEL, awarded by Rolls Royce Power Engineering Group, UK.

title: Vertical Integration
description: Started in-house manufacturing of Air Handling Units (AHUs) and Air Washer Units.

title: Commonwealth Projects
description: HVAC service provider for stadiums and hotels supporting the 2010 Commonwealth Games in Delhi.

title: Expansion into MEPF
description: Scaled from specialised HVAC service to comprehensive multi-discipline MEPF solutions, strengthening nationwide execution capacity.

title: Large-Scale MEPF Milestone
description: Awarded MEPF contract for Mopa International Airport — a significant step into high-value, large-scale infrastructure execution.

title: Critical Pandemic Support
description: Led pandemic-support operations through continuous HVAC O&M across NCR hospitals — uninterrupted facility uptime under the most demanding conditions.

title: Entered Data Centre Vertical
description: Entered the data centre sector with STT Mumbai (₹30+ Cr), expanding into high-uptime, mission-critical infrastructure.

title: Entered Semiconductor Vertical
description: Entered the semiconductor industry, executing Class 1000 cleanroom infrastructure projects for Foxconn (Apple) in Bangalore.
